datasets.name: Ods_wspaymentemant
datasets.sql:
select*from ws_paymentemanat





order by status asc

datasets.name: Ods_wssysdate
datasets.sql:
SELECT TO_CHAR(sysdate, 'HH24:MI') AS saat, sysdate
FROM dual

datasets.name: ods_wsinfo
datasets.sql:
select w.id as temid, a.kli_id,a.id as acc_id, a.acc_no,w.amount,a.filial,a.val_acc
from ws_temppayment_emanat w,account a where w.account=a.acc_no 
and w.id=:w_id

datasets.name: ods_arxipayment
datasets.sql:
select p.* from ws_payment_emanat p where trunc(sys_date)=:v_dat

order by sys_date desc

datasets.name: Ods_sum
datasets.sql:
select sum(amount)as amount from ws_paymentemanat





order by status asc
